fixes.title: Put your biggest proof next to the headline
fixes.now: "Trusted by 500+ home services companies" is a single line with nothing to back it up, and your reach across 35 states, Puerto Rico, Canada and Australia is only on the About page.
fixes.preview: The 500+ figure up top with your reach as its source line, beside a customer quote. Buyers believe a number when it comes with context.

fixes.title: Testimonials a contractor can trust
fixes.now: All eight testimonials show a first name and last initial only, like "Kyle H." and "Nick R.", with no company or trade. A roofer can't tell whether any of them run a business like theirs.
fixes.preview: Each quote with the person's company and trade. The dashed label shows where it goes.

fixes.title: FAQ answers that match their questions
